svg.text: cyber.local · EVE-NG + VMware Workstation · Attack → Logs → Detection → Investigation → Report
· Hybrid outbound NAT hides internal VLANs
· Native VLAN 999 · DTP off · trunk pruning
· PortFast + BPDU Guard on access ports
· No internet, no DNS to the DC
· Docker via sudo only (no docker group)
· NTP: R1 master → all hosts, UTC
All VLAN gateways = .254 on R1 · Isolated lab, no production systems · Cisco/Microsoft images not included
